tasks.short: Check chemical and supply levels, write stock down, tell the supervisor what to order, and store deliveries safely.

steps.what: Cleaner checks levels of soap, wax, chemicals and cloths in the store
Cleaner writes the inventories of supplies on a paper list
Cleaner tells the supervisor which supplies run low
Supervisor orders supplies from the supplier
Cleaner unpacks deliveries and stores chemicals safely

tasks.design: The wash's dosing units show chemical drum levels on the wash controller screen ({OPS_SYSTEM}), and dry goods use two bins with a barcode card that the cleaner scans when the first bin is empty. Levels below minimum and scanned cards make a reorder list that goes to the supervisor; ordering and storing stay as they are.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supplies were checked by eye and listed on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Wash dosing systems can report levels, and barcode two-bin systems are cheap.
tasks.still_hard: Minimum levels must be set right; cards get lost.
tasks.human_edge: Noticing a leaking drum or a wrong chemical delivered.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in decision rights; counting shrinks.

reach.learn: Whether two-bin cards work in small stores.

evidence.claim: Wash dosing systems can report chemical levels, and barcode two-bin cards trigger reorders.
Scans logged per person can observe performance; record per store, not per cleaner.

assumptions: Boundary: from checking levels to stocking the store; supplier choice is outside.
Input contract: minimum levels and item cards set by the supervisor; drum levels from the dosing units installed by the wash supplier; fallback is the paper list.
Supervisor time is outside the cleaner's savings.
unknowns: Whether the dosing units can report levels.
Number of items in the store.
research_questions: Do stock-outs of chemicals fall after two-bin cards?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Small washes with few items save little counting time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Watch the wash machines run, stop them when something goes wrong, tell the supervisor, log the fault and clear simple problems.

steps.what: Cleaner monitors operation of cleaning machines through each cycle
Cleaner stops machines when malfunctions occur
Cleaner walks to the office or phones to notify supervisors
Cleaner writes the fault in the paper machine log
Cleaner clears blockages and restarts after simple faults

tasks.design: Fault codes from the wash controller ({OPS_SYSTEM}) show on a screen in the bay and the cleaner's phone, so the cleaner need not watch every cycle. One tap sends the code, a photo and a note to the supervisor and writes the fault log; stopping the machine and clearing simple faults stay with the cleaner.
tasks.previous_blocker: Faults were only noticed by watching, and logs were paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Wash controllers raise fault codes that can be sent as alarms.
tasks.still_hard: Not every fault raises a code; a car stuck in the brushes still needs eyes.
tasks.human_edge: Hitting the stop button before a mirror is torn off.

reach.learn: Whether logged codes show recurring faults.

evidence.claim: Automatic wash controllers raise fault codes that can be sent as alarms.
Logging faults per machine touches no high-risk AI area.

assumptions: Boundary: from a running cycle to restart after a fault; repairs are outside.
Input contract: fault codes from the wash controller set up by the wash supplier; supervisor contact kept by the supervisor; fallback is watching and paper.
Logs are per machine, not per cleaner.
Stopping and clearing faults do not change.
unknowns: Whether the controller can send alarms.
research_questions: Does downtime fall when faults reach the supervisor at once?

incremental.description: Cleaner learns the alarm screen and message.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Hand-wash sites with few machines have little to monitor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The vehicle cleaner keeps the washing and the quick fixes; counting and watching every cycle shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A cleaner who spends the shift washing, not counting or standing guard by the machine.
